title.en: What a finite stretch verifies, and what none can refute
title.zh: 有限片段所证实者，与无片段能否证者

statement.en: Open classes of histories are the verifiable ones, with no premise; refuting is verifying the complement. Every reading is its hull met with a remainder no finite stretch refutes, dense exactly where it is decided at each stretch whether the reading can still hold.
statement.zh: 历史的开类即可证实类，无需前提；否证即证实补集。每个读法都是其包与一个无有限片段能否证的余部之交，余部恰在每个片段处判定读法是否仍可成立时稠密。

laws.en: A reading of points read as ideals is verifiable where every point inside has a stretch through which only points inside pass; the interior holds only points inside, is verifiable and holds every verifiable part.
laws.zh: 以理想读出的点的读法可证实，指每个在内的点都有一个只有在内的点经过的片段；内部只含在内的点，可证实，并包含每个可证实的部分。

laws.en: Refuting is verifying the complement, with no premise; a stable verifiable reading has a refutable complement; a point adhering to a reading lies outside the interior of its complement.
laws.zh: 否证即证实补集，无需前提；稳定的可证实读法有可否证的补集；附着于读法的点不在其补集的内部。

laws.en: A class of ideals is open exactly where it is the class meeting an upper set of stretches, the set fixed by its finite histories; open is verifiable with no premise either way, and refutable is complement open.
laws.zh: 理想之类为开，恰当它是与片段的一个上集相交的类，该集由其有限历史确定；开即可证实，两向都无需前提；可否证即补集为开。

laws.en: Open classes hold every union and every meet of two; the interior is the largest open subclass. Asked of every order, a verifiable class has a refutable complement exactly under double-negation elimination.
laws.zh: 开类含每个并与两者之交；内部是最大的开子类。对每个序要求时，可证实类有可否证补集恰在双重否定消去之下。

laws.en: On runs: Horizon's Verifiable is verifiability at stretches; a run is verified where a stretch of it is a stretch only of runs inside, the largest verifiable part; refuting a reading is verifying its complement.
laws.zh: 在运行上：Horizon 的 Verifiable 即在片段处可证实；运行被证实，指它有一个只属于在内运行的片段，这是最大的可证实部分；否证读法即证实其补集。

laws.en: A run lies in an open class of histories exactly where a finite history of it does; a reading of runs is verifiable exactly where it is the reading of an open class; verifiable readings hold meets and unions, refutable ones joins of two.
laws.zh: 运行在一个历史开类中，恰当其某个有限历史在其中；运行读法可证实，恰当它是某个开类的读法；可证实读法对交与并封闭，可否证读法对两者之并封闭。

laws.en: Asked of every process, a verifiable reading has a refutable complement only under Markov's principle; a reading both verifiable and refutable is decided by a finite stretch of each run at which it is decided.
laws.zh: 对每个过程要求时，可证实读法有可否证补集仅在马尔可夫原则之下；既可证实又可否证的读法，在每个它已被判定的运行上由一个有限片段判定。

laws.en: Every reading is its hull met with its remainder, holding wherever it is adhered to: the largest part so splitting it, the reading itself where it is adhered to; a reading is closed exactly where its remainder holds everywhere.
laws.zh: 每个读法都是其包与其余部之交，余部即凡附着处皆成立：这是如此分解它的最大部分，在附着处即读法本身；读法为闭恰当其余部处处成立。

laws.en: No finite stretch refutes the remainder; it is met through every stretch up to double negation, and outright where it is decided whether the reading can still hold there.
laws.zh: 没有有限片段否证余部；它经过每个片段都被遇到，至多差双重否定；在判定读法在该处是否仍可成立时则直接成立。

laws.en: The disjunctive remainder, holding or not adhering, is the same split within the remainder; asked of every process, its density is exactly excluded middle.
laws.zh: 析取余部（成立或不附着）给出同一分解并含于余部；对每个过程要求时，其稠密恰是排中律。

laws.en: What a finite stretch finds against a reading is exactly what it finds against its hull, so readings with one hull are refuted by the same stretches; a dense reading, and every remainder, is refuted by no stretch.
laws.zh: 有限片段对读法所发现的反证，恰是它对其包所发现的，故同包的读法被同样的片段否证；稠密读法以及每个余部都不被任何片段否证。

laws.en: A refutable reading refuted by no stretch excludes nothing, up to double negation; a reading whose remainder is refutable holds, up to double negation, wherever it is adhered to.
laws.zh: 不被任何片段否证的可否证读法不排除任何东西（至多差双重否定）；余部可否证的读法，在其附着处成立（至多差双重否定）。

laws.en: A practice keeping verdicts within a favoured reading, each fixed by the record so far and met through its stretch, exists exactly where the reading is dense; a refutable favoured reading so kept excludes nothing.
laws.zh: 一种做法把结论保持在所偏好的读法之内，每个结论由迄今记录确定并经过该记录的片段被遇到；它恰在该读法稠密时存在；如此保住的可否证读法不排除任何东西。

laws.en: In the Boolean sequences, some move being true is verifiable and dense; recurrence is dense and not verifiable, as it is not refutable.
laws.zh: 在布尔序列中，某步为 true 可证实且稠密；复现稠密且不可证实，正如它不可否证。

hypotheses.en: No axiom and no premise: the order of stretches is any preorder, the points and readings arbitrary, the process arbitrary. remainder_dense_of_decided takes, as a hypothesis, the decision at each stretch whether a run of the reading passes through it; double-negation elimination, excluded middle and Markov's principle appear only as the calibrated sides of verifiable_compl_refutable_iff, orNotAdheres_dense_iff_em and verifiable_compl_refutable_markov.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理、不加前提：片段之序是任意预序，点与读法任意，过程任意。remainder_dense_of_decided 以“在每个片段处判定是否有读法中的运行经过它”为假设；双重否定消去、排中律与马尔可夫原则只作为 verifiable_compl_refutable_iff、orNotAdheres_dense_iff_em 与 verifiable_compl_refutable_markov 被校准的一侧出现。

does_not_show.en: Which readings of an actual inquiry are verifiable, refutable or dense: that depends on the process they are read on.
does_not_show.zh: 实际探究的哪些读法可证实、可否证或稠密：这取决于读它们的过程。

does_not_show.en: That a reading no finite record refutes lacks standing: recurrence is dense and can be an honest hypothesis about an unending course.
does_not_show.zh: 不被任何有限记录否证的读法就没有地位：复现是稠密的，可以是关于无尽进程的诚实假说。

does_not_show.en: That the remainder is dense without a decision: asked of every process, the density of the disjunctive remainder is exactly excluded middle.
does_not_show.zh: 不经判定余部即稠密：对每个过程要求时，析取余部的稠密恰是排中律。

does_not_show.en: That a verifiable reading has a refutable complement without a decision: asked of every order it is exactly double-negation elimination, and on runs it gives Markov's principle.
does_not_show.zh: 不经判定可证实读法就有可否证补集：对每个序要求时恰是双重否定消去，在运行上给出马尔可夫原则。

detail.en: In the Boolean sequences recurrence is dense, not verifiable (the run of true throughout adheres to its complement) and not refutable (the run of false throughout adheres to it): no finite record counts for or against it (recurs_dense, recurs_not_verifiable, Horizon's recurs_not_refutable).
detail.zh: 在布尔序列中复现稠密、不可证实（处处为 true 的运行附着于其补集）且不可否证（处处为 false 的运行附着于它）：没有有限记录支持或反对它（recurs_dense、recurs_not_verifiable、Horizon 的 recurs_not_refutable）。

Built and reviewed in one session, with no separate reviewer; author review in study section 205; not independently reviewed by a person.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261019T130853.816105Z）：Becoming.Verification 的 109 项声明（91 项定理）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。在一个会话中构建并审查，没有另设审查者；作者审查见研究第 205 节；未经人的独立审查。

next_delta.en: The three cases of the demarcation assessment read on actual inquiries; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 划界评估的三种情形读到实际探究上；独立审查。

correspondence.en: Open classes of ideals are the Scott-open sets, on runs the open sets of the topology of runs; verifiable and refutable readings are the open and closed classes of formal learning theory (Kelly 1996); the split is the decomposition of every property into a safety and a liveness property (Alpern and Schneider 1985), the remainder its largest liveness part. Readings (the AI's): a verification must find a stretch it is only known not to miss; systematic insulation of a favoured verdict, the pattern the demarcation assessment of SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY names, keeps a verdict no finite record refutes; separating what a reading says that a record can count against from what none can is deciding, at each stretch, whether it can still hold.
correspondence.zh: 理想的开类即 Scott 开集，在运行上即运行拓扑的开集；可证实与可否证读法即形式学习理论的开类与闭类（Kelly 1996）；分解即每个性质分为安全性与活性性质之交（Alpern 与 Schneider 1985），余部是其最大的活性部分。读法（AI 的）：证实必须找到一个只知道不会错过的片段；对所偏好结论的系统性免疫（SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY 的划界评估所指的模式）保住的是没有有限记录能否证的结论；把读法中记录能反对的与不能反对的分开，就是在每个片段处判定它是否仍可成立。

detail.en: Reuses the order of stretches, ideals, directed unions, the hull, closed classes, avoidance and the two-element chain of Becoming.Ideals, and Becoming.HistoryIdeals' runs as ideals with their laws.
detail.zh: 复用 Becoming.Ideals 的片段之序、理想、有向并、包、闭类、回避与二元链，以及 Becoming.HistoryIdeals 中作为理想的运行及其律。

output.en: Histories as ideals of their stretches, the hull as the least closed class, closed classes as lower sets.
output.zh: 作为片段理想的历史，作为最小闭类的包，作为下集的闭类。

input.en: The open classes, dual to the closed ones, and the split of a reading with its hull.
input.zh: 与闭类对偶的开类，以及读法与其包的分解。

detail.en: Reuses Becoming.Horizon's Run.AgreeUpTo, Refutable, Verifiable and Adheres, the sequences and Markov's principle: Verifiable is read here at stretches and its complement calibrated.
detail.zh: 复用 Becoming.Horizon 的 Run.AgreeUpTo、Refutable、Verifiable 与 Adheres、序列及马尔可夫原则：此处在片段处读 Verifiable 并校准其补集。

output.en: Agreement up to a horizon, refutability, verifiability and adherence of readings of runs.
output.zh: 到一界的一致，以及运行读法的可否证、可证实与附着。

input.en: The readings of runs whose verification, interior and split are stated.
input.zh: 其证实、内部与分解被陈述的运行读法。

detail.en: The formal side of the demarcation comparison: a practice that insulates its favoured verdict keeps a verdict no finite record refutes.
detail.zh: 划界对照的形式一面：对所偏好结论加以免疫的做法，保住的是没有有限记录能否证的结论。

detail.en: The next levels: readings verified or refuted in the limit, where settling and recurrence sit.
detail.zh: 下一层级：极限中被证实或被否证的读法，以及止定与复现所处的位置。
